name: RARE Air: Daily Trivia
subtitle: Rare answers. Higher flights.
shortDescription: Daily trivia. Rare answers lift your balloon. Play online or practice offline.
promotionalText: Meet on the flight deck: quick matches, rated tables and friend invites. Explore 150 free chapters, nine skies and eight earned companions. Ten languages.
description:
Take your knowledge above the clouds.

RARE Air is an open-answer trivia game about finding the less obvious answer. Each flight gives you five questions and 30 seconds per question. Type one correct answer and your hot-air balloon climbs. Rarer answers give you a bigger lift.

A FRESH DAILY FLIGHT
Everyone gets the same five prompts each day. Explore geography, science, books, films, history and everyday knowledge. A new challenge opens at midnight UTC.

FIND YOUR UPDRAFT
Correct answers earn 100, 250, 500 or 1,000 meters, based on fixed editorial rarity tiers. Aim for a 5,000-meter flight and review accepted answers after the final stage.

A SKY THAT RESPONDS
Drag your balloon to steer. Tap it to catch a gust. Rare answers bring cloud breakthroughs, wind rings and paper-plane companions. Turn on sound for extra atmosphere. Native haptics add feedback on supported devices, and reduced-motion settings simplify the flight.

KEEP EXPLORING
Choose from nine free practice topics online, take a mixed five-question flight, revisit past daily flights, or play from 601 bundled practice prompts offline. Offline history stays on your device. An optional free flight passport synchronizes completed online flights across devices.

FLIGHT ROUTES
Explore 150 chapters across nine free routes: 30 each in World, Movies, Books and Games, and six each in five other subjects. Later chapters reuse reviewed questions in distinct fixed combinations. Complete a chapter to unlock the next, save your best altitude and earn stars. Each route has its own illustrated sky.

DAILY STREAKS
Complete the current daily flight on consecutive UTC dates. Unlock cosmetic flight trails at 3, 7, 14 and 30 days. Choose an earned trail from your flight log. Eight companions unlock at best streaks of 5, 14, 30, 45, 60, 75, 100 and 150 days.

PLAY WITH FRIENDS
Choose two-, three-, six- or ten-seat Sky Relay tables. Invite friends privately, browse public waiting rooms or find a quick match. Optional passport-only rated flights track Elo ratings. Automatic tables start when full, with up to 30 stages. Rare answers charge extra hearts. There are no simulated opponents; invite friends or choose a smaller table when queues are quiet.

YOUR FLIGHT PASSPORT
Create a free passport without an email address. Save its private recovery code to restore online history and progress on another device. Invite friends with expiring links and compare daily answers after completing the same daily flight. Block or report pilots. Delete your passport and linked online history from its recovery controls. Passkeys can also be managed on the website.

TEN LANGUAGES
Choose English, Chinese, Spanish, French, Portuguese, German, Japanese, Russian, Arabic or Indonesian. Answer in your selected language or English.

SHARE YOUR FLIGHT
Send a spoiler-free scorecard through your phone’s share sheet. Compare daily altitudes on the anonymous leaderboard.

Daily challenges, online practice, chapters, streak progress, multiplayer, the archive and leaderboards require an internet connection. Offline practice works without a connection. Rarity tiers are curated editorial ratings. The game is free and has no in-app purchases.
reviewNotes:
Guest daily play, practice and private/quick multiplayer require no account. Offline practice bundles 601 prompts. Optional rated play and friends use a free flight passport: choose Flight passport, enter a nickname, create it and save the displayed recovery code. No email, password, paid membership or developer-provided test account is needed. Sign out and restore with that code to verify cross-device login. Open Recovery and deletion, enter the current code, confirm and choose Delete passport to delete the account and linked online history. Web entry: https://krillionunlimited.top/?passport=delete. Passkeys are optional on the website; the native app uses recovery codes.

Choose Play with friends for 2/3/6/10-seat tables, quick matching, public room browsing and passport-only rated matching. A private room lets two review devices join by code and the host start. Automatic tables start when full. No simulated opponents are present. Rare/exceptional answers charge one extra heart per 1,500 meters, capped at five. Block/report controls are available for other pilots.

Flight routes has150 chapters; the original first six remain unchanged. Four major subjects have30 chapters and other subjects six. Later chapters reuse the reviewed bank. Eight earned companions use daily streak milestones5/14/30/45/60/75/100/150.

Five prompts per solo flight,30seconds per prompt. Choose Climb higher after each reveal; a three-second countdown starts the next server clock. Active online timers continue in the background. Offline practice and history are local. Source: https://github.com/glovenone/rare-air. Cloudflare Workers,D1 and Durable Objects provide the online service. Advertising and purchases are disabled.
